title: Quantitative Fourier decay for Patterson-Sullivan measures of dimension larger than $1/2$
summary: We give an elementary proof of power Fourier decay for Patterson-Sullivan measures associated to convex co-compact Schottky groups of dimension $δ>\frac12$, obtaining the explicit decay exponent $\frac{δ(2δ- 1)}{(2δ+ 1)(3 - δ)}$. The proof replaces the technical machinery used in previous works, such as sum-product estimates, renewal theory, Dolgopyat methods, and $L^2$ flattening, by elementary oscillatory integral estimates, hyperbolic geometry, and a duality argument based on the transpose Schottky group.
